meta.title: Kinavela — Keep roots alive. Create closeness.
meta.description: A private, trusted platform connecting diaspora families through culture, community and memories.

hero.title: Keep roots alive. Create closeness.
hero.body: Kinavela brings nearby families together, nurtures small trusted communities and helps parents keep language, culture and family stories alive for their children.
hero.privacy: Private by default · No public child profiles · No exact home locations

journey.title: From first connection to lasting memory

steps.title: Discover
steps.body: Find compatible families nearby with deliberately imprecise location display.

steps.title: Connect
steps.body: Private conversation only opens after both families agree.

steps.title: Build a Village
steps.body: Create cultural experiences in small, trusted local communities.

steps.title: Preserve memories
steps.body: Keep language, stories and meaningful moments in a private Roots Passport.

trust.title: Families need trust, not reach.
trust.body: Children are never standalone users. Profiles, media and memories remain under the control of authorized parents and guardians.
items: Distance ranges instead of exact coordinates

cta.title: A calmer way to build community.
cta.body: Create your protected family space now and keep culture, language and memories alive together.

connections.title: Connections built on mutual trust
connections.intro: A connection opens only after the invited family accepts. Contact details, exact locations and child profiles remain private.
